    if (!href) return;
    const isExternal =
      href.startsWith("http") &&
      !href.includes(window.location.hostname);
    const isPDF = href.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");
    if (isExternal || isPDF) {
      link.setAttribute("target", "_blank");
      link.setAttribute("rel", "noopener noreferrer");
    }
  });
});

<script>

  links.forEach(link => {

    if (!href) return;
    const isExternal =
      href.startsWith("http") &&
      !href.includes(window.location.hostname);
    const isPDF = href.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");
    if (isExternal || isPDF) {
      link.setAttribute("target", "_blank");
      link.setAttribute("rel", "noopener noreferrer");
    }
  });
});
